title: EvaluatorInput
description: The image is what is under review. The claim is the specification it is checked against. One image per call.

image_path.description: Path on the local filesystem to the math visual under review (absolute, or relative to the process working directory). The file is read in the caller's environment and its bytes attached to the model request; the format is identified by file signature, not extension. Bounds are declared in `x-image` and enforced by the SDK before any model call; an image outside them is rejected, not resized. Every supported model downscales beyond the maximum edge, so resize to it on the long edge before submission.

claim.description: The specification the image is checked against. Either a claim about what the image shows ("The chart shows 12 apples.") or a question with its expected answer in the form `Question: "<question>" The answer is <answer>.`
